text:
Jonah: Escalating — trial account 'BrightBox' (ACC BRIGHT-001) is hitting persistent 500s and embed timeouts during onboarding flows. Demo scheduled tomorrow; customer blocked. Logs show embed_timeout after ~15s and tokens spike. Marking P1 and handing to CS for comms and enablement.
Luca: Can you paste the smallest error snippet and the last request ID?
Jonah: req_id=rb-9f3a2c, snippet: `embed_timeout: context fetch failed after 15000ms`. Also seeing 429s from model-router when concurrency spikes. Rolling restart didn't help.
Maya: Putting this on my radar. @Priya @Amir can you join a sync in ~15m? We need an immediate comms plan and a temporary mitigation for the demo.
Priya: On it — I can join. I'll prep a short runbook for the call: 1) acknowledge 2) mitigation (lite model) 3) ETA + follow-up. Who will own the actual customer note?
Amir: I'll triage infra routing. My initial read: fallback routing not triggering to compact model on overload. Opening infra ticket and will push a routing override if safe.
deploy-bot: Deploy task queued: override-routing/compact-fallback -> queued by @Amir
Maya: Comms plan (short): 1) Send initial note to Amy (AMY@brightbox.com) with apology + scheduled recovery call (10:30 PST tomorrow) + temporary workaround (switch to 'redwood-compact-v1') 2) Offer credit if SLA breached 3) Follow-up post-call with root cause and timeline. I'll own the draft and customer outreach.
Jonah: Confirming call window 10:30 PST tomorrow. Attaching screenshot of client error in the thread.
Priya: Draft looks good — I'll be on the call to run through the integration steps and enable the lite model. Also prep a short demo showing identical UX with fewer tokens.
Maya: Roles: CS lead = Maya, Support lead = Jonah, Infra lead = Amir, Solutions = Priya. Communication owners: Maya sends initial email, Jonah posts postmortem link, Amir posts infra ticket updates. I'll log this as CS-ESC-2026-042 and create a calendar invite for the recovery call.
Luca: I'll capture the logs/trace and hand off to Amir in the infra ticket. If we need a rollback of recent model-routing config, call it out.
Jonah: Notifying customer now with the 10:30 PST slot. Adding support note: 'We have a mitigation ready (compact model) and a recovery call scheduled.'
Maya: Thanks team. After call we'll publish a short playbook to reduce trial friction: pre-warm KV cache + fallback config. Will post to #eng-runtime and attach to the CS case.
Priya: +1 — once we confirm the fix we'll push an enablement checklist for new trials.
Amir: Infra ticket created: INF-1228. I toggled fallback to compact model for BRIGHT-001 as a temporary measure. Monitoring now.
Jonah: Noted — customer replied: "Thanks for the quick response; we'll join the call." We're good for now. I'll update the case after the call.
Maya: Closing this thread for now — follow-ups will be in the CS case (CS-ESC-2026-042) and infra ticket INF-1228. Thanks everyone. :pray:
